name: @cng/format-gpkg
description: GeoPackage output for @cng/download-core: a hand-written SQLite 'vector features' profile (gpkg_contents/gpkg_spatial_ref_sys/gpkg_geometry_columns + the feature table), built with sql.js. The ~340KB (min+gz) path O5 chose over gdal3.js's 2-8MB wasm build -- see README.md and experiments/e10-heavy-formats/RESULTS.md.
